text: Reputation can underwrite tokenized assets and provide immutable guarantees for them, and with reputation staked guarantees tokenized assets can over time function like real assets.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098
